# tomswallapi_netmap (Resource)

A network-to-network mapping (netmap), anchored at a device:zone or device:interface. It renders on the anchored device with the zone resolved to its bound interface.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_netmap" "remap" {
  type     = "dnat"
  from_net = "203.0.113.0/28"
  to_net   = "192.0.2.0/28"
  anchor   = "fw1:net"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `anchor` (String) Anchor as device:zone or device:interface.
- `from_net` (String) Network (CIDR) to match.
- `to_net` (String) Network (CIDR) to rewrite to.
- `type` (String) dnat or snat.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Server-assigned id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_netmap.remap 42
```
